cover: Tests to run on your prototype before launch

slides.title: Two accounts, each other's data
slides.body: Sign in as two people and try to open each other's records, including by calling the app directly.

slides.title: Database rules from outside
slides.body: Test exposed tables without signing in, then with an account that should have limited access.

slides.title: Search for secrets
slides.body: Check the code and its history for payment keys and passwords. Rotate anything that reached the repo or the browser.

slides.title: Restart it
slides.body: Restart the app and check the records are still there. Make sure someone's actually restored a backup at least once.

slides.title: Break an outside service
slides.body: Make payments, email or sign-in slow or unavailable and see what users get. Submit a form twice while you're at it.

slides.title: Ship and roll back
slides.body: Have someone other than the builder deploy a release and roll it back, then check the records and screens.
